reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 12 points better, in a game of about 221 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Thunder.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Thunder win 86 times in 100, by about 14; most games like this end between 195 and 243 total points.
